title: HTTP Datagram Lifecycle and Intermediary Conversion Work Item
summary: Add trace-owned HTTP Datagram lifecycle and intermediary conversion decisions for the remaining RFC 9297 requirements.
planned_changes:
- Add lifecycle decisions for request support, extension override, send-side openness, receive-side closure, uncreated streams, HTTP/1.x start policy, and flow-control checks.
- Add intermediary conversion decisions for DATAGRAM frame and DATAGRAM Capsule bridging.
- Add Capsule payload length and redundant length validation.
- Add extension-limit discard and no-full-buffering policy helpers.
- Add focused tests and canonical xrefs.
verification_plan: Run the HTTP/3 package build, focused lifecycle/intermediary policy tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, QUIC requirement coverage triage generation, and diff hygiene before commit.
out_of_scope: CONNECT-UDP request setup and UDP forwarding.
CONNECT-IP address assignment and IP packet forwarding.
Live QUIC DATAGRAM effect scheduling inside the transport runtime.
completion_notes: The RFC 9297 requirement set is fully trace-owned across foundation, Capsule Protocol policy, and lifecycle/conversion policy slices.
